bio1: I'm Harry Chang. I build safety systems for language models, take photographs on cameras without screens, and argue for positions I'm not sure I believe in. The tools keep changing. The questions stay the same.
bio2: Admitted to NTU CSIE through Special Admission and graduating Chingshin Academy this July. I work across research, photography, debate, and film, convinced each medium will teach me what the last one couldn't.
bio3: From LEGO bricks to language models, the urge to take things apart never quite left. Curious how it all connects? Explore the map.
